llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及316L不锈钢的激光选区熔化工艺参数优化，未考虑生物医学植入物所需的应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on achieving low porosity and high build rates in SLM of 316L, with no link to biomedical implant design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现316L不锈钢SLM低孔隙率与高成形速率
summary_zh.method: 通过优化激光功率、扫描速度等工艺参数调控孔隙率
summary_zh.result: 在高成形速率下获得了低孔隙率致密试样
summary_zh.validation: 密度测量与力学性能测试验证工艺有效性

summary_en.motivation: To achieve low porosity while maintaining high build rates in selective laser melting of 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.method: Process parameters such as laser power and scanning speed were optimized to control porosity and densification.
summary_en.result: Fully dense parts with low porosity were produced at high build rates.
summary_en.validation: Density measurements and mechanical testing were used to validate the process optimization.
